C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_skill_sets.xml:2185: <SkillSet id="spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_skills">
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_skill_sets.xml:2205: <SkillSet id="spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_skills">
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:801: <!-- DOLGULDUR wanderer backstories -->
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:802: <string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}Knowledge is the truest weapon, and I have spent a lifetime gathering it..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:803: <string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}I studied the ancient arts of Dol Guldur, learning the secrets of construction and siege-craft from the Necromancer's own engineers. My family served as builders for generations, raising walls and forging defenses." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:804: <string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}But when a rival accused me of weakening our fortifications for the enemy, I was cast out despite my innocence. The walls I built still stand, though my name has been struck from the builders' rolls." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:805: <string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}Now I wander, offering my knowledge to those who value skill over politics. The Shadow grows, and the uruks of the fortress need fortifications more than ever." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:806: <string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}A builder's skills are worth more than a warrior's in these dark times." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:807: <string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}Stone walls won't stop what's coming." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:808: <string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}If you need one who can build as well as fight, I am at your service." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:809: <string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}A pit-boss from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:810: <string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}My blade has tasted the blood of many foes, yet I fight on..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:811: <string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}I was a champion of Dol Guldur, trained since youth in the arts of war. My skill with blade and shield earned me renown among the uruks of the fortress, and I served the Necromancer with unwavering loyalty." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:812: <string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}But honor demanded I challenge a corrupt commander who sent soldiers to die for personal glory. I won the duel but lost my position - the commander had powerful allies who saw me banished." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:813: <string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}Now I sell my sword to worthy causes. the elves and men of the West grows bolder each day, and there is no shortage of battles to fight for those with the courage to face them." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:814: <string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}A warrior who fights for honor deserves respect." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:815: <string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}Perhaps you should have been more careful about choosing your battles." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:816: <string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}My blade is yours, if you'll have it." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:817: <string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}A skull-crusher from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:818: <string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}The wild places hold secrets that town-folk never dream of..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:819: <string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}I served as a scout in Dol Guldur, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the dark pits and can track a fox through running water." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:820: <string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the elves and men of the West. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:821: <string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}I refused to look away and paid the price. Now I range alone, using my skills to survive and help those who cross my path. The wilds are dangerous, but at least they're honest." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:822: <string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}The truth is worth any price." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:823: <string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}Sometimes survival requires compromise." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:824: <string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}I offer my eyes, my bow, and my knowledge of the wild." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:825: <string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}A shadow-scout from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:826: <string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}I have seen too many die from wounds that could have been healed..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:827: <string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}I trained as a healer in Dol Guldur, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the uruks of the fortress. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the elves and men of the West, saving countless lives." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:828: <string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}But when a noble's son died despite my best efforts - the wound was beyond any healer's skill - his father blamed me and demanded my execution. I fled rather than face a rigged tribunal." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:829: <string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}Now I practice my art wherever I can, helping the sick and wounded regardless of their allegiance. Death does not discriminate, and neither should healing." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:830: <string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}A healer's compassion is a rare gift." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:831: <string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}Healing enemies only makes more work for warriors." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:832: <string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}If you value the lives of your people, let me tend to them." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:833: <string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}A poison-mixer from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:834: <string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}Gold opens doors that swords cannot..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:835: <string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}I built a trading network across Dol Guldur, connecting the uruks of the fortress with goods from distant lands. My caravans brought prosperity and rare supplies that the Necromancer valued highly." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:836: <string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}But a jealous merchant house conspired to frame me for smuggling contraband. They seized my warehouses, scattered my contacts, and left me with nothing but the clothes on my back and the knowledge in my head." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:837: <string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}Now I seek to rebuild, one deal at a time. The coming war will need supplies and logistics, and I know every trade route from the Hill of Sorcery to the far reaches." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:838: <string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}Commerce is the lifeblood of any campaign." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:839: <string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}Pretty words from someone who lost everything." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:840: <string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}I can make your gold stretch further than you'd believe. Hire me." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:841: <string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}A loot-keeper from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:842: <string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}In the shadows, one learns the true nature of power..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:843: <string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}I grew up in the back alleys of Dol Guldur, learning to survive by wit and quick hands. Eventually, I was recruited by the Necromancer's intelligence network, using my skills for the uruks of the fortress's benefit." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:844: <string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}But when I uncovered a conspiracy reaching into the highest circles of power, I became a liability. Those I served decided I knew too much and sent assassins. I killed two of them and fled." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:845: <string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}Now I trust no one but myself, though I'd rather use my skills openly than skulk in shadows forever. the elves and men of the West has spies everywhere, and someone needs to counter them." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:846: <string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}A shadow-worker who serves the light is valuable indeed." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:847: <string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}How can anyone trust a self-admitted spy?" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:848: <string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}I work best when no one sees me coming. Will you have me?" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:849: <string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}A throat-cutter from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:850: <string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}Battles are won in the mind before a single blade is drawn..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:851: <string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}I commanded forces in Dol Guldur, studying the art of war under the Necromancer's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the elves and men of the West when we were outnumbered." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:852: <string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}But a jealous superior took credit for my victories and blamed me for a retreat that saved our army from annihilation. The council sided with him - he had connections I lacked." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:853: <string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}Stripped of rank, I now offer my mind and experience to those who judge by merit, not birth. The coming war will need commanders who can think, not just those who can swing a sword." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:854: <string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}A thinking warrior is the most dangerous kind." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:855: <string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}Plans rarely survive contact with the enemy." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:856: <string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}Let me plan your campaigns, and I'll show you what strategy can achieve." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:857: <string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}A war-chief from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:858: <string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}The ring of hammer on steel is the music I was born to play..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:859: <string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}I was a master smith in Dol Guldur, crafting weapons and armor that the uruks of the fortress prized above all others. My forge produced blades that could cleave through enemy armor like parchment." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:860: <string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}But I refused to craft weapons for a corrupt lord who planned to use them against innocent people. He burned my forge and had me beaten. I survived, but my workshop was destroyed." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:861: <string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}Now I carry my skills wherever I go, maintaining and improving the arms of those I travel with. A good blade in trained hands can change the course of a battle." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:862: <string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}A craftsman of principle is rare and precious." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:863: <string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}Principles don't keep you warm in winter." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:864: <string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}Keep me fed and give me a forge, and I'll keep your steel sharp." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:865: <string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}A iron-bender from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:866: <string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}There is no freedom like the wind in your face atop a swift horse..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:867: <string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}I served in the mounted forces of Dol Guldur, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the elves and men of the West's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the uruks of the fortress." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:868: <string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}During a raid, my commander ordered us to trample fleeing civilians - they might be enemy sympathizers, he said. I refused and was court-martialed for disobedience." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:869: <string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}Now I ride alone, my lance for hire to those who fight with honor. The open road suits me better than garrison duty ever did." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:870: <string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}A rider who values life over orders has true courage." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:871: <string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}Disobedience in battle can cost more lives than it saves." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:872: <string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}Give me a mount and a cause worth riding for." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:873: <string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}A warg-rider from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:874: <string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}An arrow loosed at the right moment can change history..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:875: <string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}I was the finest marksman in Dol Guldur, able to split an arrow at two hundred paces. I served as the Necromancer's personal guard archer, watching over the uruks of the fortress from the highest vantage points." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:876: <string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}But I witnessed my captain murder a prisoner in cold blood and reported it. The captain was connected to powerful families, and suddenly I was the one accused of crimes I didn't commit." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:877: <string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}I escaped before they could silence me permanently. Now I offer my bow to those who still believe in justice. Every arrow I loose carries the memory of that murdered prisoner." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:878: <string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}Justice is worth fighting for, even at great cost." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:879: <string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}The dead don't care about justice." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:880: <string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}My bow is steady and my aim is true. Will you have me?" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:881: <string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}A eye-poker from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\features\spider.md:5: > For the skeleton / mesh / animation authoring pipeline (the in-Blender + Modding-Kit side), the current source of truth is [`docs/features/spider-skeleton-animation-pipeline.md`](spider-skeleton-animation-pipeline.md). C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\features\spider.md:9: Giant spiders are a recruitable troop of Dol Guldur. Bannerlord cannot host a non-humanoid creature as an ordinary `NPCCharacter` (the `race=` field resolves against a humanoid-only `skins.xml`), so the troop uses a **humanoid anchor** (`taom_spider_creature`, `race="dg_uruk"`) for everything the troop system needs — recruitment, party roster, UI — and a thin Harmony prefix swaps the agent's body to the spider **Monster** at spawn time. The recruit shows a humanoid silhouette in the party roster but spawns and fights as a giant spider in battle.
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\features\spider.md:15: - **Rideable mount** (spider as a `HorseItem` ridden by an uruk) — abandoned because (1) a mounted creature gets a campaign-map party icon, and building that icon calls `Skeleton.ForceUpdateBoneFrames()` which threw an `AccessViolationException` (a hard, game-breaking crash on entering the open world), and (2) a single skinned mesh has a native per-draw-call bone limit (~40–58) that the spider's 8-leg mesh exceeds, so only 4 legs rendered.
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\features\spider.md:18: The recruitable-troop approach sidesteps the mount crash entirely (a troop never becomes a mount, so it never gets a map icon → never hits `ForceUpdateBoneFrames`) and puts the spider on the normal live-agent spawn path.
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\features\spider.md:24: `Mission.SpawnAgent(AgentBuildData)` needs a `BasicCharacterObject` anchor, and the troop XML pipeline rejects `race="spider"` at load. The fix: a humanoid anchor character (`taom_spider_creature`, `race="dg_uruk"`) carries the troop through recruitment/roster/UI, then a Harmony prefix on the universal spawn chokepoint rewrites the agent body to the spider Monster.

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-behaviortrees-inlining-2026-05-24.md:266: **Claim:** After the v1.4.5 rename, `BehaviorTreeAgentComponent` overrides `AgentComponent.OnTick(float)`, and vanilla `Agent.Tick(float)` automatically calls `component.OnTick(dt)` for every component attached with `agent.AddComponent(comp)`. The Warg and Spider mission behaviors still manually call `comp.OnTick(dt)` from `OnMissionTick`, and vanilla then calls the same component again later in the same mission frame via `TickAgentsAndTeamsImp`. This doubles BT evaluation/advancement for every warg/spider and doubles the hot-path work; because the trees use 10ms root delays and stateful tasks, this can advance selectors/sequences and attacks faster than intended, not just add harmless overhead.

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:209: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_1_text" text="Servos do Necromante" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:211: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_1_desc" text="Sua família servia diretamente ao Necromante, executando seus desígnios sombrios e impondo sua vontade por toda a região." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:213: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_2_text" text="Forjadores do Aço Sombrio" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:215: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_2_desc" text="Sua família forjava armas e armaduras imbuídas com a magia sombria de Dol Guldur, equipando seus exércitos para a conquista." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:217: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_3_text" text="Mineradores dos Salões Sombrios" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:219: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_3_desc" text="Sua família labutava nas profundezas das cavernas de Dol Guldur, extraindo recursos para alimentar sua máquina de guerra." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:221: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_4_text" text="Guerreiros do Bosque Encantado" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:223: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_4_desc" text="Sua família era composta por guerreiros ferozes que lutaram para estender a sombra de Dol Guldur sobre as terras circundantes." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:225: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_5_text" text="Caçadores da Floresta Negra" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:227: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_5_desc" text="Sua família caçava as criaturas distorcidas da floresta e rastreava aqueles que ousavam invadir o domínio do Necromante." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:229: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_6_text" text="Canalhas de Dol Guldur" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:231: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_6_desc" text="Sua família era composta por espiões e sabotadores, espalhando a influência de Dol Guldur através de decepção e medo." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:601: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_1_text" text="Serviu aos cavaleiros do Necromante." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:603: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_1_desc" text="Você cavalgou a serviço de Dol Guldur, comandando corcéis sombrios e espalhando terror pelas regiões do sul da Floresta das Trevas." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:605: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_2_text" text="Guardou os salões de sombra." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:607: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_2_desc" text="Você defendeu os salões sombrios de Dol Guldur, montando guarda sobre o domínio do Necromante com arco e lâmina." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:609: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_3_text" text="Treinou nas artes sombrias da guerra." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:611: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_3_desc" text="Você aprimorou suas habilidades nas artes sombrias da guerra, aprendendo a lutar com astúcia e decepção nos corredores ensombrecidos de Dol Guldur." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:613: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_4_text" text="Caçou invasores na Floresta Verde corrompida." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:615: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_4_desc" text="Você foi enviado para a vegetação retorcida do sul da Floresta das Trevas para rastrear e eliminar aqueles que se aproximavam do domínio do Necromante, aprendendo a perseguir presas pela floresta corrompida sem fazer um som ou deixar uma marca." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:617: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_5_text" text="Marchou nas legiões sombrias de Dol Guldur." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:619: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_5_desc" text="Você treinou nas fileiras de disciplina férrea das legiões sombrias de Dol Guldur, aprendendo a empunhar armas pesadas em formação enquanto a corrupção da fortaleza do Necromante se instalava em seu passo e seu silêncio." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:621: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_6_text" text="Moveu-se pela escuridão como mensageiro do Necromante." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:623: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_6_desc" text="Você carregava mensagens pela floresta corrompida que ninguém ousaria escrever, entregando-as pessoalmente a agentes que nunca mostravam seus rostos. O trabalho exigia silêncio, paciência e a habilidade de atacar sem aviso quando a sombra assim exigisse." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:985: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_1_text" text="Exercitou nos pátios sombrios de Dol Guldur." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:987: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_1_desc" text="Você treinou nos pátios sem luz da fortaleza do Necromante, aprendendo a lutar com alabarda e lâmina grande sob o olhar de supervisores encapuzados. A sombra que jazia sobre o lugar infiltrou-se em seus ossos e afiou seus instintos para violência." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:989: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_2_text" text="Forjou aço-sombrio nas oficinas escuras." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:991: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_2_desc" text="Você trabalhou nas forjas de ferro negro de Dol Guldur, aprendendo a moldar armas sob condições que quebrariam um jovem mais fraco. Os materiais eram sombrios e os métodos mais sombrios ainda, e você saiu com conhecimento que poucos admitiriam ter." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:993: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_3_text" text="Carregou pedras nas cavernas da fortaleza." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:995: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_3_desc" text="Você trabalhou nas escavações subterrâneas de Dol Guldur, arrastando blocos e escoando túneis na escuridão permanente sob a colina corrompida. O trabalho era implacável, e resistência era a única moeda que comprava qualquer alívio." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:997: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_4_text" text="Lutou nas patrulhas sombrias da Floresta Encantada." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:999: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_4_desc" text="Você correu com as patrulhas sombrias que empurravam a corrupção de Dol Guldur mais para dentro do sul de Mirkwood, cortando a resistência com machado e lança. Cada incursão o levava mais fundo na floresta retorcida e deixava menos de seu eu anterior para trás." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1001: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_5_text" text="Caçou nas bordas da floresta sombria." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1003: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_5_desc" text="Você rastreou pela vegetação rasteira corrompida do sul de Mirkwood, matando qualquer criatura que chegasse muito perto da fortaleza e aprendendo a se mover sem fazer som numa floresta que torcia cada trilha. Seus olhos se ajustaram a um mundo sem luz solar." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1005: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_6_text" text="Moveu-se pelas sombras como espião do Necromante." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1007: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_6_desc" text="Você foi usado como mensageiro e agente na rede do Necromante, carregando mensagens pela floresta sombria e entregando-as a contatos que nunca mostravam seus rostos. Você aprendeu que sombras eram sua armadura e silêncio sua melhor arma." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1369: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_1_text" text="Você comandou a patrulha que primeiro rompeu as defesas norte de Mirkwood." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1371: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_1_desc" text="Os guardas de fronteira Élficos haviam mantido a aproximação por duas estações. Você identificou a brecha na rotação deles, cronometrou sua travessia ao minuto, e trouxe sua patrulha de ida e volta sem uma baixa. Os mestres das sombras notaram seu relatório e te deram um comando permanente." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1373: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_2_text" text="Você forjou armas de aço-sombrio que passaram na inspeção de qualidade de Sauron." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1375: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_2_desc" text="Os inspetores do Necromante haviam rejeitado dois lotes anteriores dos ferreiros da fortaleza. Você reformulou o processo de fundição, não aceitou compromissos na têmpera, e entregou um lote que o inspetor examinou em silêncio antes de marcar como aprovado. Foi a primeira aprovação desse tipo em três anos." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1377: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_3_text" text="Você completou a expansão do nível de masmorra mais baixo da fortaleza." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1379: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_3_desc" text="O trabalho havia parado por uma estação devido a infiltração de água subterrânea e suportes falhando. Você redesenhou a drenagem, substituiu as vigas comprometidas, e completou o nível no cronograma revisado. Os supervisores do Necromante moveram prisioneiros na mesma semana." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1381: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_4_text" text="Você rompeu a vigilância externa Élfica e capturou um prisioneiro para interrogatório." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1383: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_4_desc" text="A inteligência obtida do guardião Élfico descreveu a rotação completa da patrulha da fronteira leste de Thranduil. Foi a informação estratégica mais útil que Dol Guldur havia recebido em um ano. Ninguém perguntou como você tirou o prisioneiro. Você não explicou." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1385: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_5_text" text="Você mapeou as rotas de patrulha Élficas no sul de Mirkwood ao longo de seis meses." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1387: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_5_desc" text="Trabalhando sozinho e ao longo de múltiplas estações, você construiu um quadro completo das disposições da fronteira sul de Thranduil. O mapa resultante deu aos planejadores de Dol Guldur algo que nunca haviam tido antes: certeza. Os agentes do Necromante o usaram por dois anos." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1389: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_6_text" text="Você se infiltrou na corte do Rei Élfico como comerciante e relatou o que ouviu." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1391: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_6_desc" text="Três meses nos salões de Thranduil sob uma identidade falsa te deram acesso a conversas que nenhum agente de Dol Guldur jamais havia escutado. Você voltou com nomes, planos e relacionamentos que os mestres das sombras usaram para moldar a estratégia da próxima estação. Você achou a experiência inesperadamente informativa sobre os Elfos." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1571: <string id="aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text" text="O conhecimento é a mais verdadeira das armas, e passei uma vida inteira reunindo-o..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1573: <string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text" text="Estudei as artes antigas de Dol Guldur, aprendendo os segredos da construção e da engenharia de cerco com os próprios engenheiros do Necromante. Minha família serviu como construtores por gerações, erguendo muralhas e forjando defesas." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1575: <string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text" text="Mas quando um rival me acusou de enfraquecer nossas fortificações para o inimigo, fui expulso apesar de minha inocência. As muralhas que construí ainda estão de pé, embora meu nome tenha sido riscado dos registros dos construtores." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1577: <string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text" text="Agora vagueio, oferecendo meu conhecimento àqueles que valorizam habilidade acima da política. A Sombra cresce, e os uruks da fortaleza precisam de fortificações mais do que nunca." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1579: <string id="aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text" text="As habilidades de um construtor valem mais que as de um guerreiro nestes tempos sombrios." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1581: <string id="aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text" text="Muralhas de pedra não vão deter o que está por vir." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1583: <string id="aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text" text="Se você precisa de alguém que possa construir e lutar, estou a seu serviço." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1585: <string id="aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text" text="Um capataz das minas de Dol Guldur, buscando propósito e aventura." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1587: <string id="aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text" text="Minha lâmina provou o sangue de muitos inimigos, e ainda assim continuo lutando..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1589: <string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text" text="Fui um campeão de Dol Guldur, treinado desde a juventude nas artes da guerra. Minha habilidade com lâmina e escudo me rendeu renome entre os uruks da fortaleza, e servi ao Necromante com lealdade inabalável." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1591: <string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text" text="Mas a honra exigiu que eu desafiasse um comandante corrupto que enviava soldados para morrer por glória pessoal. Venci o duelo mas perdi minha posição - o comandante tinha aliados poderosos que me viram banido." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1593: <string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text" text="Agora vendo minha espada a causas dignas. Os elfos e homens do Oeste ficam mais ousados a cada dia, e não há escassez de batalhas para lutar por aqueles com coragem para enfrentá-las." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1595: <string id="aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text" text="Um guerreiro que luta pela honra merece respeito." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1597: <string id="aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text" text="Talvez devesse ter sido mais cuidadoso ao escolher suas batalhas." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1599: <string id="aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text" text="Minha lâmina é sua, se você a aceitar." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1601: <string id="aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text" text="Um esmaga-crânios de Dol Guldur, buscando propósito e aventura." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1603: <string id="aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text" text="Os lugares selvagens guardam segredos que os habitantes das cidades jamais sonhariam..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1605: <string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text" text="Servi como batedor em Dol Guldur, percorrendo longas distâncias além de nossas fronteiras para vigiar por ameaças. Conheço cada trilha pelos poços escuros e posso rastrear uma raposa através de água corrente." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1607: <string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text" text="Durante uma patrulha, descobri uma conspiração entre nosso próprio povo - contrabandistas trabalhando com os elfos e homens do Oeste. Quando reportei, descobri que os contrabandistas haviam comprado proteção de alguém poderoso. Disseram-me para esquecer o que eu tinha visto." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1609: <string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text" text="Recusei-me a desviar o olhar e paguei o preço. Agora percorro sozinho, usando minhas habilidades para sobreviver e ajudar aqueles que cruzam meu caminho. As terras selvagens são perigosas, mas pelo menos são honestas." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1611: <string id="aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text" text="A verdade vale qualquer preço." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1613: <string id="aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text" text="Às vezes a sobrevivência exige compromisso." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1615: <string id="aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text" text="Ofereço meus olhos, meu arco e meu conhecimento da selva." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1617: <string id="aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text" text="Um batedor das sombras de Dol Guldur, buscando propósito e aventura." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1619: <string id="aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text" text="Vi muitos demais morrerem de ferimentos que poderiam ter sido curados..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1621: <string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text" text="Treinei como curandeiro em Dol Guldur, aprendendo as propriedades de cada erva e remédio conhecidos pelos uruks da fortaleza. Cuidei dos feridos após cada escaramuça com os elfos e homens do Oeste, salvando incontáveis vidas." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1623: <string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text" text="Mas quando o filho de um nobre morreu apesar de meus melhores esforços - o ferimento estava além da habilidade de qualquer curandeiro - seu pai me culpou e exigiu minha execução. Fugi ao invés de enfrentar um tribunal manipulado." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1625: <string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text" text="Agora pratico minha arte onde quer que possa, ajudando os doentes e feridos independentemente de sua lealdade. A morte não discrimina, e a cura também não deveria." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1627: <string id="aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text" text="A compaixão de um curador é um dom raro." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1629: <string id="aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text" text="Curar inimigos só cria mais trabalho para os guerreiros." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1631: <string id="aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text" text="Se você valoriza as vidas do seu povo, deixe-me cuidar deles." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1633: <string id="aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text" text="Um misturador de venenos de Dol Guldur, buscando propósito e aventura." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1635: <string id="aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text" text="Ouro abre portas que espadas não conseguem..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1637: <string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text" text="Construí uma rede de comércio por toda Dol Guldur, conectando os uruks da fortaleza com mercadorias de terras distantes. Minhas caravanas trouxeram prosperidade e suprimentos raros que o Necromante valorizava muito." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1639: <string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text" text="Mas uma casa mercante invejosa conspirou para me incriminar por contrabando. Eles tomaram meus armazéns, dispersaram meus contatos e me deixaram com nada além das roupas do corpo e o conhecimento na minha cabeça." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1641: <string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text" text="Agora busco reconstruir, um negócio por vez. A guerra que se aproxima precisará de suprimentos e logística, e eu conheço cada rota comercial da Colina da Feitiçaria até os confins distantes." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1643: <string id="aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text" text="O comércio é a força vital de qualquer campanha." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1645: <string id="aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text" text="Palavras bonitas de alguém que perdeu tudo." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1647: <string id="aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text" text="Posso fazer seu ouro render mais do que você imagina. Contrate-me." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1649: <string id="aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text" text="Um guardião de tesouros de Dol Guldur, buscando propósito e aventura." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1651: <string id="aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text" text="Nas sombras, aprende-se a verdadeira natureza do poder..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1653: <string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text" text="Cresci nos becos de Dol Guldur, aprendendo a sobreviver com astúcia e mãos ágeis. Eventualmente, fui recrutado pela rede de inteligência do Necromante, usando minhas habilidades em benefício dos uruks da fortaleza." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1655: <string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text" text="Mas quando descobri uma conspiração que alcançava os círculos mais altos do poder, me tornei um problema. Aqueles a quem servi decidiram que eu sabia demais e enviaram assassinos. Matei dois deles e fugi." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1657: <string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text" text="Agora não confio em ninguém além de mim mesmo, embora prefira usar minhas habilidades abertamente do que me esconder nas sombras para sempre. Os elfos e homens do Oeste têm espiões em todo lugar, e alguém precisa detê-los." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1659: <string id="aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text" text="Um trabalhador das sombras que serve a luz é valioso de fato." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1661: <string id="aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text" text="Como alguém pode confiar em um espião assumido?" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1663: <string id="aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text" text="Trabalho melhor quando ninguém me vê chegando. Vai me aceitar?" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1665: <string id="aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text" text="Um cortador de gargantas de Dol Guldur, buscando propósito e aventura." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1667: <string id="aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text" text="Batalhas são vencidas na mente antes que uma única lâmina seja sacada..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1669: <string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text" text="Comandei forças em Dol Guldur, estudando a arte da guerra sob os capitães mais experientes do Necromante. Minhas inovações táticas venceram vários confrontos contra os elfos e homens do Oeste quando estávamos em desvantagem numérica." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1671: <string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text" text="Mas um superior invejoso levou o crédito pelas minhas vitórias e me culpou por uma retirada que salvou nosso exército do aniquilamento. O conselho ficou do lado dele - ele tinha conexões que eu não tinha." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1673: <string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text" text="Destituído de patente, agora ofereço minha mente e experiência àqueles que julgam pelo mérito, não pelo nascimento. A guerra que se aproxima precisará de comandantes que saibam pensar, não apenas aqueles que sabem brandir uma espada." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1675: <string id="aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text" text="Um guerreiro pensante é o tipo mais perigoso." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1677: <string id="aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text" text="Planos raramente sobrevivem ao contato com o inimigo." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1679: <string id="aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text" text="Deixe-me planejar suas campanhas, e mostrarei o que a estratégia pode alcançar." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1681: <string id="aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text" text="Um chefe de guerra de Dol Guldur, buscando propósito e aventura." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1683: <string id="aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text" text="O som do martelo no aço é a música que nasci para tocar..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1685: <string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text" text="Eu era um mestre ferreiro em Dol Guldur, forjando armas e armaduras que os uruks da fortaleza prezavam acima de todas as outras. Minha forja produzia lâminas que podiam cortar armaduras inimigas como pergaminho." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1687: <string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text" text="Mas me recusei a forjar armas para um lorde corrupto que planejava usá-las contra pessoas inocentes. Ele queimou minha forja e mandou me espancar. Sobrevivi, mas minha oficina foi destruída." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1689: <string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text" text="Agora carrego minhas habilidades para onde quer que eu vá, mantendo e aprimorando as armas daqueles com quem viajo. Uma boa lâmina em mãos treinadas pode mudar o rumo de uma batalha." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1691: <string id="aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text" text="Um artesão com princípios é raro e precioso." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1693: <string id="aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text" text="Princípios não te mantêm aquecido no inverno." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1695: <string id="aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text" text="Mantenha-me alimentado e me dê uma forja, e manterei seu aço afiado." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1697: <string id="aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text" text="Um moldador de ferro de Dol Guldur, buscando propósito e aventura." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1699: <string id="aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text" text="Não há liberdade como o vento no rosto no topo de um cavalo veloz..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1701: <string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text" text="Servi nas forças montadas de Dol Guldur, patrulhando as fronteiras e atacando rapidamente grupos de invasão dos elfos e homens do Oeste. Minha equitação era incomparável entre os uruks da fortaleza." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1703: <string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text" text="Durante uma investida, meu comandante ordenou que pisoteássemos civis em fuga - eles poderiam ser simpatizantes inimigos, ele disse. Me recusei e fui submetido a corte marcial por desobediência." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1705: <string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text" text="Agora cavalgo sozinho, minha lança a serviço daqueles que lutam com honra. A estrada aberta me convém melhor do que o serviço de guarnição jamais convinha." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1707: <string id="aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text" text="Um cavaleiro que valoriza a vida acima das ordens possui verdadeira coragem." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1709: <string id="aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text" text="Desobediência em batalha pode custar mais vidas do que salva." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1711: <string id="aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text" text="Dê-me uma montaria e uma causa pela qual valha a pena cavalgar." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1713: <string id="aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text" text="Um cavaleiro de warg de Dol Guldur, buscando propósito e aventura." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1715: <string id="aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text" text="Uma flecha disparada no momento certo pode mudar a história..." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1717: <string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text" text="Eu era o melhor arqueiro de Dol Guldur, capaz de partir uma flecha a duzentos passos. Servi como arqueiro da guarda pessoal do Necromante, vigiando os uruks da fortaleza dos pontos mais altos." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1719: <string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text" text="Mas testemunhei meu capitão assassinar um prisioneiro a sangue frio e o denunciei. O capitão tinha conexões com famílias poderosas, e de repente eu era o acusado de crimes que não cometi." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1721: <string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text" text="Escapei antes que pudessem me silenciar permanentemente. Agora ofereço meu arco àqueles que ainda acreditam em justiça. Cada flecha que disparo carrega a memória daquele prisioneiro assassinado." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1723: <string id="aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text" text="A justiça vale a pena lutar por ela, mesmo a um grande custo." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1725: <string id="aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text" text="Os mortos não se importam com justiça." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1727: <string id="aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text" text="Meu arco é firme e minha mira é precisa. Você me aceita?" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1729: <string id="aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text" text="Um fura-olhos de Dol Guldur, buscando propósito e aventura." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:209: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_1_text" text="死灵法师的仆从" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:211: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_1_desc" text="你的家族直接服侍于死灵法师麾下,执行他的黑暗命令,在整个地区贯彻他的意志。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:213: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_2_text" text="暗影钢铁的铸造者" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:215: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_2_desc" text="你的家族锻造注入多尔哥多黑暗魔法的武器和盔甲,为其军队装备以征服四方。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:217: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_3_text" text="暗影殿堂的矿工" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:219: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_3_desc" text="你的家族在多尔哥多的深层洞穴中劳作,开采资源以供养其战争机器。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:221: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_4_text" text="魔法森林的战士" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:223: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_4_desc" text="你的家族是凶猛的战士,为将多尔哥多的阴影扩展到周边土地而战。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:225: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_5_text" text="黑暗森林的猎手" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:227: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_5_desc" text="你的家族狩猎森林中的扭曲生物,并追踪那些胆敢擅闯死灵法师领地的人。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:229: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_6_text" text="多尔哥多的游荡者" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:231: <string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_6_desc" text="你的家族是间谍和破坏者,通过欺骗和恐惧传播多尔哥多的影响力。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:601: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_1_text" text="服侍死灵法师的骑兵。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:603: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_1_desc" text="你在多尔哥多服役,指挥黑暗战马,在幽暗密林南部地区散播恐怖。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:605: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_2_text" text="守卫阴影大厅。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:607: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_2_desc" text="你守卫着多尔哥多的黑暗大厅,用弓箭与利刃看守着死灵法师的领域。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:609: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_3_text" text="接受黑暗战争艺术的训练。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:611: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_3_desc" text="你在黑暗战争艺术中磨练技艺,学习在多尔哥多阴暗的走廊中以狡诈与欺骗进行战斗。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:613: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_4_text" text="在腐化的幽暗密林中狩猎入侵者。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:615: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_4_desc" text="你被派往幽暗密林南部扭曲的灌木丛中,追踪并消灭那些靠近死灵法师领地的人,学会了在腐化的森林中无声无息地追踪猎物,不留下任何痕迹。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:617: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_5_text" text="在多尔哥多的暗影军团中行军。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:619: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_5_desc" text="你在多尔哥多黑暗军团铁一般纪律的队列中操练,学习在编队中挥舞重型武器,死灵法师堡垒的腐化渗入你的步伐与沉默之中。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:621: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_6_text" text="作为死灵法师的信使在黑暗中穿行。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:623: <string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_6_desc" text="你在腐化的森林中传递着无人敢写下的消息,亲手送达给从不露面的密探。这项工作需要沉默、耐心,以及当阴影有所要求时毫无预兆地发起攻击的能力。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:985: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_1_text" text="在多尔哥多的暗影练武场操练。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:987: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_1_desc" text="你在死灵法师要塞无光的庭院中训练,在兜帽监工的注视下学习挥舞戟矛和巨剑。笼罩此地的阴影渗入你的骨髓,磨砺了你对暴力的本能。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:989: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_2_text" text="在黑暗作坊锻造暗影钢。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:991: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_2_desc" text="你在多尔哥多的黑铁熔炉工作,学习在会摧毁弱者的条件下锻造武器。材料黑暗,方法更为黑暗,你离开时掌握了少有人愿承认拥有的知识。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:993: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_3_text" text="在要塞的洞穴中搬运石头。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:995: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_3_desc" text="你在多尔哥多的地下挖掘工程中劳作,在腐化山丘下永久的黑暗中拖运石块、支撑隧道。工作无情无尽,而耐力是唯一能换取任何喘息的货币。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:997: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_4_text" text="在魔法森林的暗影巡逻队作战。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:999: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_4_desc" text="你随将多尔哥多腐化推向南幽暗密林更深处的黑暗巡逻队奔走,用斧矛砍倒抵抗者。每次出击都将你带入更深的扭曲森林,也让你从前的自我所剩更少。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1001: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_5_text" text="猎杀于黑暗森林边缘。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1003: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_5_desc" text="你追踪穿过南幽暗密林腐化的灌木丛,杀死任何靠近要塞的生物,学会在扭曲每条小径的森林中无声行动。你的眼睛适应了一个没有阳光的世界。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1005: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_6_text" text="作为死灵法师的间谍穿梭于阴影之中。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1007: <string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_6_desc" text="你被用作死灵法师情报网络中的信使和特工,穿过黑暗森林传递消息,将它们送达从不露面的联络人手中。你学会了阴影是你的盔甲,沉默是你最好的武器。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1369: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_1_text" text="你指挥的巡逻队首次突破了幽暗密林的北方防御。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1371: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_1_desc" text="精灵边境守卫已经守住了这个通道两个季节。你找到了他们轮换中的空隙,精确到分钟地计算了穿越时间,带领巡逻队往返而无一伤亡。阴影大师们注意到了你的报告,并给了你一个永久指挥权。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1373: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_2_text" text="你锻造的暗影钢武器通过了索伦的质量检验。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1375: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_2_desc" text="死灵法师的检查员已经拒绝了要塞铁匠之前的两批货。你改进了冶炼工艺,在淬火上不接受任何妥协,交付的批次让检查员默默审视后标记为合格。这是三年来的首次批准。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1377: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_3_text" text="你完成了要塞最底层地牢的扩建。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1379: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_3_desc" text="工程因地下水渗漏和支撑失效而停滞了一个季节。你重新设计了排水系统,更换了受损的木料,并按修订后的时间表完成了这一层。死灵法师的监工在同一周就把囚犯移了进来。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1381: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_4_text" text="你突破了精灵的外围哨所,抓获了一名囚犯进行审讯。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1383: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_4_desc" text="从精灵守卫那里获得的情报描述了瑟兰迪尔东部边境巡逻的完整轮换。这是多尔哥多一年来收到的最有用的战略情报。没人问你是如何把囚犯带出来的。你也没有解释。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1385: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_5_text" text="你在六个月内绘制了幽暗密林南部的精灵巡逻路线。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1387: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_5_desc" text="独自工作并跨越多个季节,你建立了瑟兰迪尔南部边境部署的完整图景。由此产生的地图给了多尔哥多的策划者他们从未拥有过的东西:确定性。死灵法师的特工使用了它两年。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1389: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_6_text" text="你以商人身份渗透进精灵王的宫廷,并报告了你听到的内容。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_cc_strings_zho-CN.xml:1391: <string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_6_desc" text="在瑟兰迪尔的殿堂中以虚假身份度过的三个月让你接触到了多尔哥多的特工从未偷听过的对话。你带回了姓名、计划和关系,阴影大师们用这些来制定下一季的策略。你发现这段经历对了解精灵出乎意料地有益。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_module_strings_zho-CN.xml:161: <string id="taom_str_faction_official.dolguldur" text="多尔哥多的仆从" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_module_strings_zho-CN.xml:163: <string id="taom_str_faction_official.dolguldur_f" text="多尔哥多的仆从" />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_module_strings_zho-CN.xml:403: <string id="taom_str_culture_description.dolguldur" text="多尔哥多的爪牙在死灵法师的指挥下,是一支黑暗而险恶的力量。他们隐藏在幽暗密林的腐化森林中,利用背叛和阴影削弱敌人。兽人、座狼和其他邪恶生物向前进军,在中土世界传播恐惧和腐朽。" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_module_strings_zho-CN.xml:435: <string id="taom_str_culture_rich_name.dolguldur" text="多尔哥多" />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_module_strings_zho-CN.xml:3479: <string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_2" text="+20%村庄志愿兵刷新速率(黑暗征召)" />
