using System;
using BehaviorTrees;
using BehaviorTreeWrapper.AbstractDecoratorsListeners;
using TaleWorlds.Core;
using TaleWorlds.Library;
using TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade;

namespace BehaviorTreeWrapper;

public class BehaviorTreeBannerlordWrapper : IDisposable
{
    private BehaviorTreeMissionLogic? _missionLogic;
    private static BehaviorTreeBannerlordWrapper? _instance;
    private bool _disposed;

    public BehaviorTreeMissionLogic? CurrentMissionLogic
    {
        get => _missionLogic;
        set
        {
            _missionLogic = value;
            _disposed = false;
        }
    }

    public static BehaviorTreeBannerlordWrapper Instance
    {
        get
        {
            if (_instance != null)
                return _instance;
            _instance = new BehaviorTreeBannerlordWrapper();
            RegisterDefaultTrees();
            return _instance;
        }
    }

    public void Subscribe(BannerlordBTListener listener) => CurrentMissionLogic?.Subscribe(listener);
    public void UnSubscribe(BannerlordBTListener listener) => CurrentMissionLogic?.UnSubscribe(listener);
    public void Subscribe(BannerlordBTTickListener listener) => CurrentMissionLogic?.Subscribe(listener);
    public void UnSubscribe(BannerlordBTTickListener listener) => CurrentMissionLogic?.UnSubscribe(listener);

    private static void RegisterDefaultTrees()
    {
        // PerformAnAttackTree registration was dropped 2026-05-24 — no TAOM tree consumed
        // "PerformAnAttackTree" via BTRegister.Build. TAOM features register their own
        // trees (e.g. "SpiderTree", "WargTree") from their respective MissionBehaviors.
        BTRegister.AddLogger(new BannerlordLogger());
    }

    internal BehaviorTree? AddBehaviorTree(string treeName, object[] args)
    {
        var logic = CurrentMissionLogic;
        if (logic == null)
        {
            InformationManager.DisplayMessage(new InformationMessage("Error adding a tree: no current MissionLogic"));
            return null;
        }
        var agent = (Agent)args[0];
        if (logic.trees.TryGetValue(agent, out _))
        {
            InformationManager.DisplayMessage(new InformationMessage("Error adding a tree to " + agent.Name + " as it already exists"));
        }
        try
        {
            var behaviorTree = BTRegister.Build(treeName, args);
            if (behaviorTree == null)
            {
                InformationManager.DisplayMessage(new InformationMessage("Error building a tree with name " + treeName));
                return null;
            }
            logic.trees[agent] = behaviorTree;
            return behaviorTree;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            InformationManager.DisplayMessage(new InformationMessage("Error building a tree " + treeName + " for " + agent.Name + ". Message " + ex.Message));
            return null;
        }
    }

    public void DisposeTree(Agent agent)
    {
        if (!_disposed && _missionLogic != null)
            _missionLogic.trees.Remove(agent);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (!_disposed)
        {
            CurrentMissionLogic = null;
            _disposed = true;
        }
    }
}

**1. KNOWN SUSPECTS**

1. **DISPUTED** — Patch45 target/signature/return safety is correct.
Evidence: installed v1.4.5 decompile has `public Agent SpawnAgent(AgentBuildData agentBuildData, bool spawnFromAgentVisuals = false)`, so Harmony parameter `agentBuildData` binds. Patch45 null-guards `_service` and returns `true` unconditionally. Patch23 also returns `true` in every prefix path. No ordering hazard found: Patch23 only reads origin/equipment and writes clothing colors; Patch45 writes Monster/NoHorses/NoWeapons.

2. **CONFIRMED, but different root cause** — AdvancedCombat does tick the shared bone-collision singleton, but the spider is still effectively inert because vanilla formation AI will not move it.
Evidence: `IBoneCollisionService` is `Reuse.Singleton`; `AdvancedCombatBehavior.OnMissionTick` calls `TickBoneChecks(dt)` every frame. However the installed external `spider` Monster has `IsHumanoid="false"` and `Mountable="true"`. Vanilla `Agent.Build` therefore forces AI controller and sets `Formation = null` for `IsMount`. `SpiderBehaviorTree` only does “no enemy near -> sleep / bite -> sleep”; it has no movement task. So bites can only happen if enemies come to the free-mount spider.

3. **CONFIRMED** — AI Dol Guldur lords can field spiders, and the current agent is not an AI formation troop.
Evidence: settlement pools include `taom_spider_creature` at `town_DG1`, `castle_DG1-3`; clan pools exclude it; culture fallback includes it. Current vanilla path treats the spawned spider as a free mount, not a formation unit. If this is “fixed” by only flipping `Mountable=false` while leaving `IsHumanoid=false`, vanilla has another crash path: `AgentHumanAILogic` will not attach `HumanAIComponent`, but AI formation update dereferences `HumanAIComponent.ParallelUpdateFormationMovement()`.

4. **DISPUTED** — Level 21 is offerable.
Vanilla tier formula: `ceil((Level - 5) / 5)`, clamped. Level 21 => tier 4. TAOM `TaomVolunteerModel.MaxVolunteerTier` returns 6. Also, vanilla assigns `GetBasicVolunteer()` into empty volunteer slots without checking tier; the cap only gates upgrades.

5. **DISPUTED** — No BT attach gap found.
Initial agents spawned before first tick skip `OnAgentBuild` because `_treesAdded=false`, then the first tick scans `Mission.Current.AllAgents`. Later agents attach in `OnAgentBuild` because `_treesAdded=true`. Vanilla `BuildAgent` adds the agent to `_allAgents` before mission behaviors receive `OnAgentBuild`.

6. **DISPUTED for current TAOM mission setup** — No cross-mission leak found when Spider is not grid owner.
`SubModule` always adds `AdvancedCombatBehavior` before `SpiderMissionBehavior`; AdvancedCombat constructs a fresh `SpatialGrid.Instance` and clears `IBoneCollisionService` on remove. Spider clears `_spiderComponents`; `BehaviorTreeMissionLogic.OnEndMissionInternal` clears BT state.

**2. VANILLA CODE**

```csharp
public Agent SpawnAgent(AgentBuildData agentBuildData, bool spawnFromAgentVisuals = false)
{
    BasicCharacterObject agentCharacter = agentBuildData.AgentCharacter;
    ...
    Agent agent = CreateAgent(agentBuildData.AgentMonster, ...);
    ...
    BuildAgent(agent, agentBuildData);
    foreach (MissionBehavior missionBehavior3 in MissionBehaviors)
        missionBehavior3.OnAgentBuild(agent, agentBuildData.AgentBanner ?? agentBuildData.AgentTeam?.Banner);
}
```

```csharp
internal void Build(AgentBuildData agentBuildData)
{
    Controller = ((!GetAgentFlags().HasAnyFlag(AgentFlag.IsHumanoid))
        ? AgentControllerType.AI
        : agentBuildData.AgentController);
    Formation = (IsMount ? null : agentBuildData?.AgentFormation);
}
```

```csharp
public override void OnAgentCreated(Agent agent)
{
    if (agent.IsAIControlled && agent.IsHuman)
        agent.AddComponent(new HumanAIComponent(agent));
}
```

```csharp
public override int GetTier(CharacterObject character)
{
    if (character.IsHero) return 0;
    return MathF.Min(MathF.Max(MathF.Ceiling(((float)character.Level - 5f) / 5f), 0),
        Campaign.Current.Models.CharacterStatsModel.MaxCharacterTier);
}
```

**3. ADDITIONAL FINDINGS**

[CRITICAL] `Main/Features/Spider/SpiderTroopSpawnService.cs:22` — ADR-007 — Service directly uses sealed `TaleWorlds.Core.Monster` and `MBObjectManager`, and the service interface accepts `AgentBuildData` instead of an adapter. Installed decompile: `public sealed class Monster : MBObjectBase`. Fix: keep `AgentBuildData`/`Monster` lookup and mutation in a boundary adapter or the Harmony patch; service should decide from primitives/adapters.

[HIGH] `Main/Features/Spider/SpiderMissionBehavior.cs:18` — Runtime behavior — “Vanilla formation AI moves the agent” is false for the installed spider Monster. External XML has `IsHumanoid="false"` and `Mountable="true"`; vanilla sets `Formation=null` for mounts and only adds `HumanAIComponent` for humans. Fix: use a troop-specific non-mount Monster plus custom movement, or implement a movement controller/BT instead of relying on vanilla formation AI.

[MEDIUM] `Main/Features/Spider/SpiderMissionBehavior.cs:47` — Combat reliability — in normal TAOM missions Spider delegates grid ownership to AdvancedCombat, whose grid refresh is 2s. Spider target detection and `CustomAttack` both depend on `SpatialGrid`; Warg’s own owner path documents 0.1s as the required combat cadence. Fix: make the shared grid owner use the combat cadence when spider/warg BTs are present.

- External `LOTRLOME_Armory`: `Monster id="spider"`, `action_set="as_spider"`, `monster_usage="spider"`, attack actions present.

Failing config/API interaction:
- External `spider` Monster still has `IsHumanoid="false"` and `Mountable="true"`, which makes the troop-spawned live agent a vanilla free mount.
